question: Padma Shri Awardee Gosaveedu Shaik Hassan is known for playing:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadaswaram**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gosaveedu Shaik Hassan** is actually known for playing the **Nadaswaram**, a traditional wind instrument used in South Indian classical music
 
• Gosaveedu Shaik Hassan is a distinguished Indian classical musician who has made significant contributions to the field of music,
 
• He has been awarded the **Padma Shri**, one of India's highest civilian honours, for his exceptional talent and contributions to music.
 
• **The award is a recognition of his dedicatio**n to preserving and promoting traditional Indian music.
 
• The **Nadaswaram is a traditional South Indian wind instrument, **often considered one of the oldest musical instruments in the region.
 
• It is **made of wood and has a conical shape, with a double-reed mouthpiece.**
 
• Playing the Nadaswaram requires considerable skill and breath control.
 
• Musicians often engage in intricate melodic patterns and improvisations, showcasing their artistry.
